long_biography.plain_text:
Goes became a director of Roots of Unity in 2000, with the role registered in investment banking. He added property-related companies and, in 2004, joined the business now named Whanau Day Nursery (Harpenden). Further designated-member appointments followed for the St Albans and Welwyn Garden City nursery partnerships, creating a long-running cluster of childcare businesses in Hertfordshire.

Whanau is a family-owned independent provider serving children from three months to five years across three settings. Goes remains a director or designated member of the registered entities and holds significant-control positions within the group. The Harpenden and Welwyn Garden City operations are registered as open full-day-care providers. His public business profile therefore shows sustained ownership and governance in childcare, while the scale and source of his wider wealth remain undisclosed.
